Token --ink (page ground). Used 2x: html,body background and the body vignette's outer stop. Same value as styles.css --ink but a SEPARATE definition: this page does not load /styles.css, so a theme set there never reaches it.
Token --panel. DEFINED BUT NEVER USED (0 var(--panel) in the file); the recessed surfaces use literals instead (#0e1319 .controls, #131a21 .v-unsure, #0d1217 .bar). Safe to repoint or drop.
Token --card. DEFINED BUT NEVER USED (0 var(--card)); .card and .skel paint a literal #161d26 -> #11161d gradient instead.

Token --line. 6 uses: .card/.skel border, .qx-btn outline, .act-share outline, .chip-disputed/.chip-pending borders. Same hex as the spec's line example; styles.css has no --line (it uses --tunnel-2/--maple-line).

Token --chalk. 9 uses: body text, .q, .done-head, .r-big.early, .r-you, .chip-disputed text, .qx-btn text, and the focus-visible outline on .vbtn/.act-next. Warmer/lighter than styles.css --chalk #E8E4D8.
Token --chalk-dim. 11 uses: .brand, h1 (the page title is DIM), .toprow, .meta, .q-def, .r-eyebrow, .chip-pending, .act-share, .done-line, .t-link, .cv-link. styles.css equivalent is #9AA0A6.

Token --amber. 14 uses: .qx-play/.act-next fills, .r-big.yes, .chip-active, .bar .y, .done-head underline, .flash, active/flashed .qx-btn text+border, amber focus rings, and the star in the inline SVG page-mark (fill="var(--amber)").
Token --ember. 5 uses: .r-big.no, .chip-none, .bar .n, .err-line. Page-local red; not the same hex as styles.css --whistle #E2654E nor the .v-no keycap reds (#F06A54/#D9422D).

notes: Literal count (assigned sources): 74 color literals by regex (#hex{3,8} | %23hex in data: URIs | rgb[a]() | hsl[a](), HTML numeric entities like – excluded); 74 entries, verified 1:1 by (line, value) per file. Breakdown: bonuses/index.html 56, each of index.html / 404.html / how-it-works / faq / can-you-go-82-0 / what-is-bpm 3 (meta theme-color + 2 favicon fills).
Plus 3 entries from traits/index.html (not assigned): /traits/ is a live redirect shell to /bonuses/ with inline body/link colors. Total entries 77.
No hsl() anywhere; no named colors used as real colors ('transparent' appears only as gradient stops in the bonuses body background, 'white' only inside 'white-space').

index.html: the #t82-live-hide style block has zero colors (display:none only). index.html has no other inline style block or style attributes; its only literals are meta theme-color and the favicon. The static #staticIntro markup uses styles.css classes and is replaced by app.js on boot.

BIGGEST REACH GAP: bonuses/index.html does NOT link /styles.css. It runs a self-contained design system (own :root tokens with the same names as styles.css but different values: --chalk #f2ede4 vs #E8E4D8, --chalk-dim #a8b0b8 vs #9AA0A6, plus --ember #E5533C instead of --whistle, plus --line/--panel/--card that styles.css lacks). A theme defined in styles.css will not reach this page at all; it needs a shared tokens file linked from both, or the theme duplicated inline.

bonuses/index.html: 47 of its 56 literals are raw values in rules or SVG attributes (8 are the :root token definitions, 1 is meta theme-color). --panel and --card are defined but never referenced; the surfaces they name are painted with literals (#161d26/#11161d card gradient, #0e1319 tray, #131a21 unsure bar, #0d1217 bar track, #1a222c/#212b36 skeleton). Two different accent-ink values (#1c1608 on .q-tag/.vbtn, #131313 on .qx-play/.act-next).

bonuses/index.html vs styles.css keycap: the vote keycaps and amber buttons are page-local geometry (16/13/15px radii, 4px extrusion, #9a6a12 edge, #FFC957/#F2A81F face) and do not use the presti-spin variables (--spin-face #E89A1C, --spin-top #F8B647, --spin-side #9E5A0F, 9px radius, 5px extrusion). The card is soft and rounded (23px) where the styles.css world is square-cornered tickets.

Static pages (how-it-works, faq, can-you-go-82-0, what-is-bpm) and 404.html have NO inline <style> and NO style attributes; their only own literals are meta theme-color and the favicon. They use these styles.css classes: site-head, brand-link, brand-logo, content-page (h1, h2, p, ul, ol, li, a), lead, btn, btn-primary, btn-block (a.btn keycap), site-foot, site-links, games-count, mono, fineprint. index.html additionally uses round-pips, ticket, intro, intro-title, intro-lead, eyebrow, static-links, dim, foot-stats, details.legal. None load app.js, so decorate3dButtons never runs there; a.btn gets the keycap from CSS alone.

Static pages link /styles.css with NO ?v= cache-bust (index.html uses ?v=20260924-riso-results-v50). A theme shipped in styles.css may render stale on these pages until caches expire; add the same version query when theming ships.

Static Play button detail: a.btn (0,1,1) beats .btn-primary (0,1,0), so the button paints goldenrod --spin-face #E89A1C, not var(--amber); .content-page a.btn-block sets its label to var(--ink) #101418, so on these pages the ground token doubles as accent-ink. A theme that lightens --t-ground will wreck this label unless a.btn-block's color moves to accent-ink.

NOT reachable from CSS: (1) meta theme-color #101418 on all 7 pages (browser chrome; needs <meta name=theme-color media=...> pairs or JS); (2) the data: URI favicon (%23101418 tile + %23FFB52E diamond) on index/404/static pages, URL-encoded, cannot take var(); bonuses/ has no favicon link at all; (3) logo.png in every styles.css page header is a raster with baked chalk-white lettering (~#E0E0E0) and gold star/hoop on transparent: on a light/paper theme the wordmark disappears, so a light theme needs a second logo asset or a CSS filter; (4) og-image.png is a baked share image (not theme-relevant on page). Reachable only with an added rule: the bonuses inline SVG page-mark uses fill/stroke presentation attributes #B98A4F (any CSS rule overrides them; rewriting as var(--maple,#B98A4F) is cleaner).

JS-set colors: none. The bonuses script builds markup with inline style attributes (skeleton heights/widths, error-card font-size, BACK button display:flex, result min-height, bar width) but no color values; functions/bonuses/[slug].js only injects window.__T82_BONUS__ JSON, no styles. Haptic switch inputs are opacity:0.

Role judgment calls: body ruled-texture rgba(242,237,228,.022) -> line (rgb is chalk/text); .card top edge rgba(242,237,228,.13) -> light (rgb is chalk); #0e1319 tray and #0d1217 bar track -> ground-2 (recessed, darker than ground; ground-3 kept for the lighter skeleton fills); #F06A54 NO-keycap top stop -> bad (no bad-hi role exists; consider adding one to mirror accent-hi); #c6ced6 UNSURE label -> text-2 (a third neutral text step found nowhere else); #0b0f13 vignette -> ground (a ground-deep step).
